feature: Friend decks (handoff design_handoff_the99_friend_decks, R2): a friend's deck read-only, friend tiles, Hidden from friends, Settings' Your decks
note: Needs SOCIAL_FRIENDS_ENABLED and FRIEND_DECKS_ENABLED on, and a friend of the audit account with decks: FRIEND_ID is their public id; FRIEND_DECK a deck with a list, FRIEND_DECK_REPEAT one whose name repeats its commander, FRIEND_DECK_EMPTY one with a commander and no cards, FRIEND_DECK_HIDDEN one hidden from friends. Built on a scratch branch by a throwaway seed, never committed. The owner's rules include drafts, since none of those decks commits.

rows.label: a deck named for its commander: the commander line drops
an empty deck (States): the Commander and the dashed box
a hidden deck's link: the app's 404 (States, gone)
